description: Inject audio into an open Voice Bridge call. Two modes: (1) text — we synthesize via OmniVoice TTS in any of 602 languages; (2) audio_base64 + encoding — bring your own audio (mulaw_8000 or pcm_l16_16000 for MVP). STT is automatically muted while we inject, so the agent doesn't hear itself. No additional payment — covered by the session deposit.

audioBase64.description: Pre-rendered audio bytes, base64 (mode 2). Use with 'encoding'.

encoding.description: Encoding of audioBase64. mp3/opus require ffmpeg (not yet wired in MVP).

language.description: Language override for this utterance (default: session language)

text.description: Text to speak (mode 1). Uses OmniVoice TTS.

voiceDescription.description: Free-form voice description for TTS (e.g., 'calm female voice')

name: voice_bridge_say
